title: Training Robust Deep Models for Time-Series Domain: Novel Algorithms and Theoretical Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the technical robustness of deep models for time-series data, particularly in high-stakes applications like mobile health to prevent patient injury. While patient safety has ethical implications, the paper's core contribution is a technical solution (novel algorithms and theoretical analysis for robustness) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical aspects, morals, or faith.
